sub: close your eyes, take a breath

cards.title: Full circle
cards.line: Someone from an old chapter comes back. This time you get to choose differently.

cards.title: A fresh start
cards.line: The next person you meet starts a new pattern, not a repeat of the last one.

cards.title: Aligning
cards.line: What you want is already moving toward you. Stay patient, it's lining up.

cards.title: Be seen
cards.line: Let them see the real you. The right one falls for exactly that.

cards.title: Protected
cards.line: You're not behind. You're being kept away from the wrong person on purpose.

cards.title: Big change
cards.line: Your love life is about to move fast. Say yes to the plan you'd usually skip.

cards.title: Choose you
cards.line: Stop shrinking to be chosen. Choose yourself first and watch who stays.

cards.title: Lucky timing
cards.line: Someone is closer than you think. A small hello turns into something real.

cards.title: Overflowing
cards.line: Love is coming from more than one direction. Get ready to be chosen.

cards.title: Let it end
cards.line: Release the one you keep checking on. You're making room for someone new.

cards.title: Make a wish
cards.line: Someone is thinking about you right now. Make the wish, they're aligning too.

cards.title: Step forward
cards.line: Stop waiting for a sign. This is the sign. Send the message.

caption:
Close your eyes, take a breath and screenshot. Which love number did you land on? Drop it in the comments and claim it.

Want to know who's aligning with you? Your chart and your matches are on Align, link in bio.
